items.title: Berger Paints Q2 profit rises 5% on higher costs
items.description: Berger Paints India recorded a consolidated net profit of ₹217.1 crore for the September quarter. Revenue from operations increased by 13.2% to ₹3,200.4 crore during the same period. The profit growth was affected by rising raw material costs and increased advertisement spending, leading to squeezed margins. Consolidated earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation rose to ₹370.7 crore. The company implemented staggered price hikes to address ongoing raw material inflation.

items.title: M&M Q2 net profit up 25% driven by strong automotive sales
items.description: Mahindra & Mahindra reported a 25% increase in consolidated net profit for the September quarter. The automotive business was the primary driver behind this profit growth, aiding other sectors. Overall revenue rose to ₹57,553 crore, reflecting strong demand despite external challenges. Standalone net profit also exceeded expectations, reaching ₹5,102 crore for the same period. This performance showcases the company’s resilience amid a difficult operating environment.

items.title: Airtel profit surges 33% to Rs 9,015 crore in Q2, outpacing Jio in ARPU growth
items.description: Bharti Airtel has reported a profit surge to ₹9,015 crore in the September quarter. Average revenue per user increased to ₹271, widening the lead over Reliance Jio. The company missed analyst profit estimates due to high network operating costs impacting margins. Bharti Airtel added 1.2 million postpaid customers during this quarter but faced subscriber growth challenges. Overall revenue rose 16.7% year-on-year, indicating strong performance despite competitive pressures.

items.title: LIC net profit jumps 20% YoY to Rs 12,076 crore on higher premiums
items.description: Life Insurance Corporation of India reported a 20% year-on-year increase in net profit for the September quarter. Net premium income rose by 16.2% to ₹1.47 lakh crore during the same period. Despite investment challenges, the company's profit growth remained strong due to higher premium income. The value of new business also increased significantly, reflecting improved margins across product categories.

items.title: Muthoot Microfin Q2 profit jumps 3.6 times to Rs 111 crore
items.description: Muthoot Microfin reported a 3.6-fold year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit to Rs 111 crore, supported by secured lending growth and improved asset quality. Total income increased 27% to Rs 733 crore, while gross NPAs declined to 3.38%.

items.title: ONGC Q2 profit jumps 57% to Rs 15,489 crore on higher oil prices, rupee depreciation
items.description: ONGC has reported a significant 57% increase in quarterly profit, reaching Rs 15,489 crore. The profit surge is attributed to higher oil and gas prices combined with rupee depreciation. Gross revenue also rose by 33% to Rs 43,875 crore during the July-September quarter. The company announced an interim dividend of Rs 8 per share, marking its highest-ever interim dividend.

items.title: Gokaldas Exports Q2 profit surges 410% to Rs 41 crore on favourable base, revenue up 13%
items.description: Gokaldas Exports reported a 410% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 41 crore, supported by growth in India and Africa operations, improved product mix and productivity gains. The company also reduced its net debt.

items.title: Hindalco Q2 Results: Revenue jumps 39% YoY to Rs 91,708 crore; profit rises 59% on one-time gain
items.description: Hindalco Industries revealed a consolidated net profit of Rs 7,532 crore for Q2 of FY27, marking a rise of about 59% from Rs 4,741 crore last year. The company boasted a revenue from operations of Rs 91,708 crore, indicating a year-on-year growth of nearly 39%. This profit takes into account certain exceptional gains and deductions, although shares dipped slightly after the results were shared.

items.title: BMW Industries Q2 Results: Net profit rise 43% YoY to Rs 21.62 crore
items.description: BMW Industries Ltd has reported an impressive 42.7 percent increase in net profit for the quarter ending on September 30. The firm's total income surged by 33 percent compared to the same quarter last fiscal year, while EBITDA rose by 25 percent, showcasing its resilience and growth. Notably, the new greenfield downstream steel complex in Bokaro commenced operations, with future plans focused on optimizing capacity utilization across these facilities.

items.title: HCC Q2 profit slumps 53% to Rs 22 crore
items.description: Hindustan Construction Company reported a decline in consolidated net profit for the September quarter of FY27. Income and expenses also saw a reduction in comparison to the previous year's figures. The company secured an order of Rs 524 crore and participated in several project bids. Additionally, construction progressed on various projects including the Indore and Patna Metro.
